stories.headline: Gold falls back as inflation concerns broaden, Yahoo Finance says; Investing.com notes miners rising on a rebound
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance's Nov. 11 gold report is headlined 'Gold prices fall back as inflation concerns broaden'. Investing.com's headline says gold mining stocks rose as bullion climbed after an inflation-driven slide. Only headlines were available; no price levels were retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: The two headlines describe a slide tied to inflation concerns followed by a bounce in bullion and miners.

stories.headline: Bitcoin sits out a stock rebound as ETF outflows continue, CoinDesk says
stories.summary: CoinDesk's Nov. 11 Crypto Markets Today headline says bitcoin did not join the stock-market rebound while ETF outflows continued. Only the headline was available; no figures were retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headline, bitcoin diverged from equities, with ETF outflows cited as continuing.

stories.headline: Alphabet's TPU reveal is overshadowed by cash-flow worries, Barchart and Motley Fool say
stories.summary: Barchart's headline says Alphabet edged higher after revealing a pair of new TPUs, but that a bigger challenge for the stock is its cash flow. A Motley Fool piece asks whether Alphabet is still a buy after free cash flow turned negative. Only headlines were available.
stories.whyItMatters: Both outlets frame negative free cash flow as the main concern around Alphabet, per their headlines.

stories.headline: Law firms keep issuing Duolingo securities class-action notices
stories.summary: Several firms, including Kaplan Fox, Pomerantz and Bragar Eagel & Squire, published investor alerts on Nov. 10 about a securities fraud lawsuit against Duolingo (NASDAQ: DUOL), with lead-plaintiff deadlines referenced. Only headlines were available; the allegations were not retrieved.
stories.whyItMatters: The notices indicate a securities class action involving Duolingo is open for lead-plaintiff applications.
